run_f_gold: run f_gold to find and print the K smallest elements from an array using O(1) extra space
test_f_gold: test f_gold with multiple parameter sets to verify K smallest element selection correctness
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that maintains K smallest elements by scanning and shifting array positions
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return the K smallest elements as a list instead of printing them
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds K smallest elements in-place using O(1) extra space and O(n*k) time
